description: This file defines a React component for managing reporting attribute mappings within an asset management system. It allows users to view, create, and edit mappings of reporting attributes linked to specific reporting programs, with CRUD operations integrated via API calls. The component handles form state, validation, and UI rendering including modals and data tables.

methods.name: buildProgramIndex
methods.description: Creates a Map from reporting program IDs to their corresponding master DTO objects for quick lookup.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares and opens the modal for creating a new reporting attribute mapping.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares and opens the modal for editing an existing reporting attribute mapping, populating form fields accordingly.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Validates form data, performs create or update operations via API, handles success/error notifications, and reloads the data.
